slides.texte: Pro Doubles Men with Antoine Bouhana. First in our age group.
The part nobody films. Our fastest kilometre was the second one: **3:06.**
In Paris this season, the same station took us 2:55. **Thirty-eight seconds** found on one station.
Station eight, 100 reps, legs empty. Our **best-ranked station** of the day.
Our weakest station in Rome. We pushed it in 1:41 in Paris, so **the work for this winter** is clear.
Four minutes in transitions, between the runs and the stations. **The cheapest time to win back.**

Thank you Antoine, for every second of it.
World Championships, here we come.

legende:
Rome. 53:34 🇮🇹

Our fastest race yet, and first in our age group (35-39) with Antoine Bouhana. 12th of 292 teams in Pro Doubles Men.

Swipe for the race, station by station: where we found time, and the one station that still costs us.

Saturday night in Rome was special. Thank you Antoine for every second of it ❤️

Next stop: the World Championships in Hong Kong, June 2027 🙏
